items: the planet slowly rotates in space, city lights twinkle, slow camera push in
golden spheres float slowly in the dark, gently drifting, light glints moving over their surfaces
the bow slowly draws across the violin strings, the strings vibrate, warm light flickers
prayer beads slowly slide one by one through the fingers, candlelight flickers
the quill pen moves slowly writing ink on the paper, the candle flame flickers
the candle flame flickers and sways gently in the darkness, soft glow pulses
